svg.aria-label: Conversion of D-glucose into D-fructose (osazone–osone route)
svg.title: Conversion of D-glucose into D-fructose (osazone–osone route)
svg.text: Conversion of D-glucose into D-fructose (osazone–osone route)
Step 1 glucose → glucosazone | Step 2 osazone → osone (C-1 aldehyde, C-2 ketone) | Step 3 selective reduction of the aldehyde end
Net result: the C=O group moves from C-1 (aldose) to C-2 (ketose): aldohexose → ketohexose.
